items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: it was a fun night, the first night of almost 20 years of nights.

ctx.x: So you’ve played with some great people. Did you have to official “audition” for instance to get with Michael MacDonald?

No. No, that, there’s a little story to that. I was introduced — well I was recommended to Michael by Christopher Cross. And I had played one gig with Christopher, it wasn’t even his gig, it was a showcase at a club in Santa Monica called At My Place. And Christopher ended up being the guitar player in the band for my friend who was showcasing, whose name was Karen Blake, a great singer. I had worked with Karen in a little female trio called Souvenir. And she wanted to do a showcase and try and get her solo…
